ClientBuildRequest.description:
A webview's bundle build (frontend/src/bundleBuild.ts), plus what the
VS Code host added (extension/src/webviewBuild.ts) — absent in the
standalone browser build.
ClientBuildRequest.title: ClientBuildRequest

DesignRequest.description: A linked figure + table's shared design (scistackplotdb.designs).
DesignRequest.title: DesignRequest

GuideLogRequest.description: One wizard event from the webview (StatStudio/Guided), for scistack.log.
GuideLogRequest.title: GuideLogRequest

MatlabCommandRequest.description:
The command generators read the raw request dict (``params``) as the
single-run/pipeline-run requests do — every field the picker sends is
forwarded. Declared open so the model does not have to repeat them.
MatlabCommandRequest.title: MatlabCommandRequest

MatlabTerminalRunRequest.description:
A run the host handed to the MathWorks terminal, for us to watch.

The host cannot see the run end — that is the whole problem — so it
tells us the run_id and we watch the markers and the database lock. See
``scistack_gui.matlab.run_watch``.
MatlabTerminalRunRequest.title: MatlabTerminalRunRequest

SchemaLevelRequest.description:
What the settings panel asks: the level a Run of this node would use,
given its current (possibly unsaved) stated value.
SchemaLevelRequest.title: SchemaLevelRequest

StudioOpenRequest.description:
Which studio opened, and from which entry point (studio-unification
Stage 0): so scistack.log says which ways in people actually use.
StudioOpenRequest.title: StudioOpenRequest
